old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-pro2","title":"Node never drives SCHC fragmentation retransmission or inactivity timers","description":"Correctness review of Node._transmit_peer_schc/_process_received and SchcSessionManager found outbound fragmented sends emit the initial batch and immediately return True, but Node retains no sender handle, schedules no 10-second retransmission timeout, and never calls FragmentSender.timeout(). If All-1 or its ACK is lost, there is no ACK REQ/retry/Sender-Abort and no completion/failure notification; the session only expires opportunistically when a later manager method happens to run. Inbound reassembly likewise has no driven 60-second timer and therefore cannot proactively emit the Receiver-Abort required by spec/03-adaptation.md §5.6. Integrate bounded per-session timers with Node lifecycle/cancellation, handle radio-send failures for repair outputs, drive the four-attempt state machine, emit terminal aborts, and test lost All-1, lost ACK, inactivity, shutdown, and successful completion.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T13:30:52.776879Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T13:30:52.776879Z"}
